record.question: The registrar of Trade Union withdraws a certificate on the ground that it was obtained by fraud, the trade union wants to challenge the order of registrar. Advise with reference to the provisions of the Trade Union Act.
options: as per Section 11 of the Act, may file an appeal to the High Court; where the head office of the Trade Union is situated within the limits of a Presidency-town

as per Section 11 of the Act, may file an appeal to such Court, not inferior to the Court of an additional or assistant Judge of a principal Civil Court of original jurisdiction, as the appropriate Government may appoint in this behalf for that area; where the head office is situated in any other area
